title: Invertible transpose of the universe-lifted transition

source.place: Tags 06YY and 09C6, normalized algebraic quotient transition; transpose under scalar restriction

proof.text: Apply the canonical-transpose intermediate theorem to the derived restriction adjunction supplied by ModuleCat.derivedRestrictScalars_isRightAdjoint. For an arbitrary left adjunction with the same right functor, use Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq and its unit equation to identify its transpose with the canonical transpose after an isomorphism of left adjoints. Isomorphisms are closed under this composition, so the arbitrary transpose is invertible.
